answer: Because each tundra escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the ember ledger records every share and the vault audit makes public the split. Assembling that for 127 aliases means 127 times 3 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 3 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
